externalMarketplaces.name: ecc
externalMarketplaces.description: Everything Claude Code (ECC) – large cross-harness skills/hooks collection. Install from the official source only (README warns third-party re-uploads may be unsafe): add via `/plugin marketplace add affaan-m/ECC` then `/plugin install ecc@ecc`. A lightweight overview skill is vendored at .claude/skills/everything-claude-code/ so it shows up without a full install.
